name: types
scope: physical field type codes; int[] by language contract

name: names
scope: physical canonical names; anonymous entries retain typed absence

name: signature
scope: ordinary positional signature description

name: signatureTypes
signature: R signatureTypes T0 ... TN; explicit fun\const\signatureTypes(left := R; right := types)
scope: same signature kind: result type token left, all ordered input tokens right

name: curry
scope: arbitrary finite arity, exact stage input type and terminal result

name: apply
scope: arbitrary actual record vector; result record including explicit void

name: partial
scope: prefix 0..N; exact residual signature, complete prefix yields thunk

name: uncurry
scope: explicit full target contract and stage failures, callable result preserved

name: flip
scope: swap first two positions of N>=2 with full input types

name: compose
scope: inner arbitrary arity; outer consumes its one result; exact final R

name: pipe
scope: compose(second; first), exact callable signature

name: identity
scope: typed T -> T for any valid value type

name: map
scope: universal sequence, ordinary callback admission/defaults, result reference vector

name: filter
scope: universal sequence; stable storage-preserving selection and int predicate

name: foldl
scope: left fold over any accumulator/item/result records

name: zip
scope: pairs of typed records, min length

name: zipWith
scope: arbitrary binary callback types, result records

name: scanl
scope: seeded scan, n+1 records; accumulator type not hardwired

name: bind
scope: Maybe of any typed record; next gets actual payload value

name: traverse
scope: Maybe of direct Structure record vector; stop at first absence

name: memoize
scope: any arity/R; explicit key-vector equality, Message-local linear cache

name: fix
scope: F(self;T0..Tn)->R becomes T0..Tn->R

name: select
scope: actual-type selection preserving dense/reference profile

name: omit
scope: actual-type omissions preserving dense/reference profile

name: rename
scope: one graph copy then canonical field names updated

name: reorder
scope: full checked permutation, any field value types

name: project
scope: one shared graph copy of selected fields

name: defaults
scope: merge(fallback; source), existing presence including uninit wins

name: diff
scope: identity-vector patch, not deep payload equality

name: patch
scope: prevalidated identity-vector patch in fresh container

name: bindFields
scope: DATA defaults through merge; residual input positions not removed

name: derive
scope: ordinary merge composition

name: transpose
scope: rectangular Structure of row values; no fixed dimensions

name: groupBy
scope: typed keys and explicit equality, stable group/member order

name: lazy
scope: typed nullary thunk, first successful result cached

name: force
scope: nullary call returning typed result record; direct thunk() keeps R

name: once
scope: any arity/R; first success reused, failure permits retry

name: repeat
scope: count calls with arbitrary typed actual vector; result records

name: runUntil
scope: record state; step then predicate, no fixed payload type

name: retryCall
scope: finite attempts, declared failures retained in FxCallFailure envelope

name: bracket
scope: any resource/result; finally release; arbitrary extra action inputs

name: recover
scope: exact signature; handler(name,payload,actualVector) -> R

name: adapter
scope: arbitrary external/internal arity, explicit new exact contract

name: permute
scope: arbitrary N, reorder interface and actuals together

name: overload
scope: explicit pure predicates, exactly one branch, full external signature

name: predicate
scope: same arbitrary inputs; normalize ordinary int Boolean output

name: guard
scope: same exact signature with precondition over all actuals

name: trace
scope: arbitrary signature, events retain typed args/result/void distinction

name: contract
scope: same signature, pre(args), post(args,result) or post(args) for void

name: composeData
scope: merge actual parent DATA with explicit data overlay

name: record
scope: prepared postfix capture; pointer to typed record, no value dereference

name: some
scope: Maybe present with any typed value record, including null

name: none
scope: Maybe absence, distinct from present empty/null value

name: ok
scope: Result success carrying any typed value record

name: err
scope: Result failure carrying any typed reason record

name: bindResult
scope: typed Result success chain, failure kept

name: list
scope: universal sequence input, shallow copied reference vector

name: flatMap
scope: universal sequence bind, no artificial list.items box

name: done
scope: terminal Bounce with result record

name: more
scope: suspended nullary callable, arbitrary captures via partial

name: trampoline
scope: iterate Bounce until done, never execute callable final result

name: range
scope: dense int range, stop excluded, checked extent

name: slice
scope: validated half-open selection preserving actual storage profile

name: reverse
scope: new reverse container, reference targets retained

name: concat
scope: one-level concatenation; same dense T or ordinary reference array

name: compress
scope: same-length int truth mask; stable profile-preserving selection

name: any
scope: ordered predicate calls, stop at first true

name: all
scope: ordered predicate calls, stop at first false

name: index
scope: Maybe of first int index, none when absent

name: count
scope: count accepted items in source order

name: replaceRange
scope: preflight then overlap-safe replacement, same target descriptor

name: splice
scope: same replacement; return a fresh shallow snapshot of removed elements, preserving dense/reference profile

name: append
scope: same target, source values fixed before writes

name: insert
scope: replaceRange at one position

name: deleteAt

name: findFirst
scope: first accepted typed element as some(record), none for absence; ordered short-circuit over dense Arrays and Structures

name: allOf
scope: arbitrary finite predicate composition with a shared ordered signature, preserved input places and short-circuit; empty set requires an explicit contract

name: equalFields
scope: ordered sequence/field equality with explicit typed comparator; unequal lengths are false, empty equal lengths are true; no implicit deep graph equality

name: retryPost
signature: retryPost(request; retryOn; attempts; delay; firstDelay; maxDelay; timeoutMs; complete)
scope: Message-owned bounded retry with saturated backoff, transport timeout and policy cancellation; persistent terminal result and late-reply draining

name: between
scope: prepared operand for inclusive ordered bounds; exactly two right values, ordinary actual comparison types and the priority of <=

name: iterateUntilStop
scope: execute accepted declaration DATA and associated body in their receiving activation; source Stop terminates, other declared exits retain name/payload in FxCallFailure; requires AE01

name: sort
scope: stable nonmutating generic merge sort; three-way int comparator; fresh outer array preserving source profile and element identity; empty/singleton supported; callback failure does not modify input

name: unique
scope: stable first-occurrence uniqueness with explicit typed equality predicate; fresh outer array preserving source profile and element identity; empty/singleton supported; callback failure does not modify input

name: take
scope: Fresh prefix; count is clamped to 0..length.

name: drop
scope: Fresh suffix after a clamped count.

name: splitAt
scope: Both slices use one clamped cut; source remains unchanged.

name: takeWhile
scope: Longest true prefix; predicate runs once per visited item, including first rejection.

name: dropWhile
scope: Suffix begins with first rejected item; no later predicates are evaluated.

name: span
scope: One prefix scan supplies both parts, without reevaluating an effectful predicate.

name: partition
scope: Stable two-way partition with exactly one predicate call per item.

name: enumerate
scope: Indices are admitted to the current int type from exact arithmetic; no wrapping index is accepted.

name: windows
scope: Positive width/step; full windows by default. partial permits one last nonempty short window. No suffix after a window reaches the end.

name: chunks
scope: Nonoverlapping chunks, final short chunk permitted unless strict; invalid size fails before iteration.

name: intersperse
scope: Insert an admitted separator between items; empty and singleton inputs do not admit an unused separator.

name: intercalate
scope: Separate sequence parts and concatenate; empty parts returns a fresh empty sequence of separator profile.

name: unzip
scope: Reverse the existing zip FxPair protocol; empty input returns two fresh empty record Arrays.

name: foldr
scope: Strict finite right fold; step(item,accumulator), right-to-left callback order.

name: scanr
scope: Right scan includes the seed at the final position; right-to-left callbacks.

name: filterMap
scope: Map to Maybe and keep present values, preserving zero/empty/reference values.

name: mapWhile
scope: Map to Maybe; stop at first none, without calling later items.

name: findMap
scope: Return the first present callback result; return none when all are absent.

name: mapAccumL
scope: step(state,item) returns FxPair(next state,output); callbacks left-to-right.

name: mapAccumR
scope: Same stateful transform, callbacks right-to-left, outputs at original positions.

name: groupAdjacent
scope: Consecutive equal-key runs; keyOf once per item and sameKey once per adjacent pair.

name: replicate
scope: Finite copies of one ready value record; negative count gives empty; reference values retain one target.

name: cycle
scope: Required finite repetition count; nonpositive count gives empty; preflight result size.

name: starmap
scope: Each ready row becomes one actual vector; one typed callback result per row. No source graph field is executed while reading it.

name: zipLongest
scope: Two sequences padded to the longer length with the explicit complete fill value record.

name: collect
scope: Nullary producer through the existing call bridge until its Stop(), or finite limit; other declared failures retain their name and payload inside FxCallFailure.

name: includes
scope: Ordered short-circuit membership with explicit typed equality; no conflict with regex contains.

name: adjoin
scope: Return original source if already present; otherwise return a fresh same-profile Array with the new value prepended.

name: union
scope: Unique first occurrences from first then second; pure equivalence relation required.

name: intersection
scope: Unique first-source values present in second, preserving first-source order.

name: difference
scope: Unique first-source values absent from second; set difference, not Haskell list multiset subtraction.

name: symmetricDifference
scope: First-only values then second-only values, each once; use existing difference and concat.

name: isSubset
scope: Every equivalence class from first appears in second; multiplicity is ignored.

name: mapOption
scope: Map one present payload to a new Maybe; absent input skips transform; Some(null) stays present.

name: filterOption
scope: Retain the same present container when an int predicate accepts its payload; absent or rejected input yields absence.

name: orElse
scope: Return the existing payload record or an already evaluated fallback record; result is not a Maybe.

name: orElseGet
scope: Return the payload record; invoke a nullary fallback only when absent.

name: orElseOption
scope: Return the original present Maybe, or call the nullary fallback once and return its Maybe unchanged.

name: foldOption
scope: Invoke exactly one branch, a nullary absent branch or unary payload branch; return its typed result record.

name: flattenOption
scope: Flatten one Maybe-of-Maybe level, retaining the nested container identity; absent outer input skips payload access.

name: mapResult
scope: Map only success payload into a fresh ok result; retain the existing error container without invoking transform.

name: mapErr
scope: Map only error payload into a fresh err result; retain the existing success container without invoking transform.

name: orElseResult
scope: Invoke one error-to-Result continuation only on err; return its Result without nesting; success identity retained.

name: foldResult
scope: Invoke exactly one unary branch with the corresponding typed payload; return its result record.

name: attempt
scope: Invoke through existing FxTry; return ok(result record) or err(typed reference record to full original FxOutcome); kernel/admission failures propagate.

name: tap
scope: Call one effect with the actual typed payload and return the exact original value record; no deep copying or swallowing failure.

name: findField
scope: Maybe of the selected physical field record; required zero-based occurrence counts equal ready names only; no payload evaluation.

name: hasField
scope: Whether that physical named occurrence exists; named uninitialized payloads count as present; no payload evaluation.

name: getField
scope: Return the existing selected field record; missing or negative occurrence raises FxIndex; no payload evaluation.

name: assoc
scope: First matching row as Maybe; keyIndex=1 covers reverse association with the same search; empty rows skipped.

name: pairlis
scope: Fresh forward-ordered key/value rows then shallow tail rows; equal lengths required.

name: getProperty
scope: Maybe of the first matching flat property value; present zero/null differs from absent.

name: setProperty
scope: Update first matching value, otherwise append a key/value pair; return same target Array.

name: removeProperty
scope: Remove first matching key/value pair; return int 1 if found, otherwise 0.

name: getProperties
scope: First property whose key matches any indicator; Maybe of key/value/index; Array index is explicit, not a Lisp cons tail.

name: asOperand
scope: Construct one ordinary OPERANDS_TEMPLATE-compatible prepared operand; present left then right actuals, exact source R/void and named failures. No new syntax mode.

name: mismatch
scope: Maybe of first differing index, or shared-prefix length when only lengths differ; no difference yields none.

name: searchSequence
scope: Maybe of first full subsequence start at or after start; empty pattern matches start; explicit equality.

name: substitute
scope: Fresh same-profile Array, replacing every equivalent element; source unchanged and referenced targets shared.

name: indexOf
scope: First literal byte-substring index at or after clamped start; -1 absent. Empty part matches the chosen valid boundary.

name: lastIndexOf
scope: Last literal byte-substring index at or before clamped start; overlapping candidates are tested, -1 absent.

name: compareText
scope: Unsigned-octet lexicographic order -1/0/1; exact case-sensitive content, length breaks an equal-prefix tie.

name: trim
scope: Fresh byte slice after removing any chosen boundary characters on both sides; default is six ASCII whitespace characters.

name: trimStart
scope: The same shared trim algorithm at the start only.

name: trimEnd
scope: The same shared trim algorithm at the end only.

name: repeatText
scope: Fresh repeated char[] through the shared generic cycle algorithm; negative count is SequenceSize.

name: padLeft
scope: Fresh byte string of at least width units; repeat then truncate fill at the left, preserve text when already long enough.

name: padRight
scope: The same shared padding algorithm with padding on the right.

name: translate
scope: Simultaneous literal byte substitution, equal-size alphabets, first duplicate source entry wins, unknown bytes retained.

name: join
scope: Join already rendered char[] parts through shared intercalate; no hidden printer or implicit coercion.

name: formatInt
scope: Exact signed bigint to lowercase digits in radix 2..36; shared with the internal nonnegative decimal name builder.

name: parseInt
scope: Strict whole-input signed bigint parse in radix 2..36; optional sign, ASCII digits case-insensitive, no whitespace/prefix/trailing text.

name: removePrefix
scope: Remove one exact leading affix when present; fresh slice either way.

name: removeSuffix
scope: The same affix-removal algorithm at the end.

name: sum
scope: Common (+ initial copy(items)) Expression over actual ready numeric fields; empty input returns the initial value record.

name: product
scope: Common (* initial copy(items)) Expression over actual ready numeric fields; empty input returns the initial value record.

name: minimum
scope: First least ordered numeric value as its original typed record; empty input raises SequenceSize.

name: maximum
scope: First greatest ordered numeric value as its original typed record; empty input raises SequenceSize.

name: argMin
scope: Zero-based first index of the least ordered numeric value, using the same extremum loop.

name: argMax
scope: Zero-based first index of the greatest ordered numeric value, using the same extremum loop.

name: extrema
scope: Pair of original minimum and maximum records; delegates to the two existing extremum directions.

name: min
scope: Choose the lesser of two typed ordered numeric value records; first identity wins ties.

name: max
scope: Choose the greater of two typed ordered numeric value records; first identity wins ties.

name: minMax
scope: Both original records in nondecreasing order; ties preserve input order and both identities.

name: clamp
scope: Closed ordered interval through shared min/max; reversed bounds raise NumericDomain.

name: sign
scope: Int -1/0/1 for ordered numeric values; no IEEE NaN or complex sign contract is claimed.

name: gcd
scope: Exact nonnegative bigint Euclidean GCD, including gcd(0;0)=0.

name: lcm
scope: Exact nonnegative bigint LCM through gcd; any zero input yields zero.

name: divMod
scope: Exact bigint floor quotient and remainder with divisor sign; zero divisor raises NumericDomain.
